scope: Local NOIRLab TAP/UWS service-behavior custody for the Longo-axis aggregate-moment campaign; not a public service-status claim
pattern: Two independent stalls on the same endpoint in under one day: gateway-pressure/job-loss and healthy-HTTP scheduler PENDING saturation
operational_lesson: HTTP 200 from TAP async proves endpoint reachability, not scheduler throughput. Several PENDING jobs with no phase progress are queue saturation, not landed work. A bounded queue-watch and early stop prevent hours of unattended service use.

canary_policy.on_executing_or_completed: report and stop; do not auto-launch full manifest
canary_policy.after_three_hours_pending: report and leave the remote job parked; do not abort
